Black Sigil - Blade of the Exiled.name: Black Sigil: Blade of the Exiled
Black Sigil - Blade of the Exiled.summary:
Bel Lenora is a world where people are born with magic at their command. Years ago, a single man walked the land with no magic in his veins. He brought death and tragedy in his wake and was banished by a brave General at a great cost. It has been fifteen years since his banishment and once again, a young man with no magic walks the land of Bel Lenora.

Join Kairu, a young knight, born with a cursed spirit...

Bratz.name: Bratz
Bratz.summary:
The GBA port of "Bratz"
This is a dance game where you can be one of the 5 Bratz girls. You can practice or make your way through the Bratz tournament.

There's a competitive dance mode and a copycat mode where you can have fun with your friends.

Hi Hi Puffy AmiYumi.name: Hi Hi Puffy AmiYumi: Kaznapped!
Hi Hi Puffy AmiYumi.summary: Help Ami and Yumi track down their annoying Number One Fan, Harmony, recover their instruments and rescue their manager, Kaz.

Iridion 3D.name: Iridion 3D
Iridion 3D.summary: In the distant regions of our galaxy, far beyond the darkest limits of the Orion Nebula, a deadly force has bee unleashed upon the universe and is heading straight for Earth. Get ready to travel forward to a time, when the fate of the universe rests in the palm of your hands! - See more at:

Medarot G - Kuwagata.name: Medarot G: Kuwagata Version
Medarot G - Kuwagata.summary:
Medarot G is a 2D action game released in 2002 for the Game Boy Advance. It was the first Medarot action game to be released in Japan.

In the Kuwagata version the player starts with Adolphin. The game mainly features characters and Medarots from Medarot 5, but some major characters from Medarot 2 also make an appearance.

The gameplay and battle system were also used in Medabots AX, which was released in North America a month earlier.

Rugrats - Castle Capers.name: Rugrats: Castle Capers
Rugrats - Castle Capers.summary: An all-new, side-scrolling platform style game featuring six huge levels based on classic fairytales with a Rugrats twist. This imaginative title features all of the Rugrats babies including Kimi, Chuckie's new stepsister.

Sound of Thunder, A.name: A Sound of Thunder
Sound of Thunder, A.summary:
Based on the Franchise Pictures movie of the same name, A Sound of Thunder takes you to a future where time travel is possible. Things quickly go wrong when someone alters the past, creating a sequence of time ripples that mutate the present-day world. Now you must solve the mystery and sort out a mess that just might mean the end of human existence.

You'll solve puzzles, manipulate items, interact with other characters, and eliminate mutant creatures and plants. In addition to a single-player mode, the game features both cooperative and competitive multiplayer modes.
